title: ML-SHARD-TRUNCATED: BTC/SOL 15m market_raw data.jsonl cut short (151,000 / 64,000 rows vs metadata 175,296 / 175,104)
owner: manager merges #18891; then the next trainer cycle proves it
note: FOUND 2026-10-13 by lane ML-DATA-OFF-TRAINER (trainer diag #17894). market_raw/BTCUSDT/15m/v002/data.jsonl has 151,000 rows (last 2026-02-01T21:45Z) but its metadata.json says row_count 175,296 (generated 00:44Z); SOL has 64,000 rows (last 2023-08-12) vs 175,104; ETH is consistent. The files were rewritten at 05:18Z / 05:42Z, ~4.5 h after the metadata, i.e. a second writer replaced the file with a prefix (round row counts). market_features and forecasts were rebuilt from the cut files, so every BTC/SOL regime unit and regime-head training reads cut data (RQ-20261012-75b2-22: n_test_rows=0). The 05Z hour is the over-subscribed catch-up hour (busy 1.96) -- correlation only, writer NOT identified. NEXT: (a) read journalctl for ict-trainer-catchup / ict-trainer / drift-retrain 05:00-05:45Z for an OOM kill or write error; read scripts/ops/build_trainer_datasets.sh BTC/SOL 15m raw build + any second market_raw writer; (b) repair: rebuild BTC/SOL 15m market_raw (Tier 2: data-mutation job) and add a row_count vs metadata check to ml/datasets/validate.py so the build fails loudly; (c) re-run the withheld units. The exporter already withholds such shards. 2026-10-14 UPDATE (MEASURED by the export integrity check in run 38503995602, 03:00Z): BTC 15m market_raw/market_features passed (row counts equal their metadata) while SOL 15m was still cut (64,000 / 63,976 rows vs 175,104 in metadata). BTC was cut at 05:18Z on 10-13 and whole at 03:00Z on 10-14, so something repaired it between; the writer is still unidentified. Hypothesis, not established: the 05Z ict-trainer-catchup hour truncates and a later rebuild restores. Check: re-run the export integrity check (ml-data-export-kaggle.yml) at ~04:50Z and ~06:40Z and compare BTC/SOL row counts to metadata around the 05Z hour. [2026-10-14 ~21:38Z lane DATA-INFRA-PROGRAMME] MORE SHARDS CUT (MEASURED, trainer-vm-diag #18108, wc -l of v002 data.jsonl): BTC 5m 157,000 rows (last close 29,923.3 -- a 2023 price; ETH 5m over the same window is whole at 525,888), SOL 5m 135,000, SOL 15m 64,000 (unchanged), ADA 15m 158,000 (last close 0.2489, 2023-era); SPLG 1d v002 has 0 rows. BTC 15m is whole (175,296). Every cut is a round thousand -> INFERRED a paged fetch (Bybit V5 kline page = 1,000 rows) stopping early, not a disk truncation. Scope of this row widens from BTC/SOL 15m to these shards; DATA-CATALOG adds the expected-rows check so the next cut is a flag, not a surprise. [2026-10-18 lane ML-UNBLOCK-1018] WRITER IDENTIFIED, ROOT CAUSE MEASURED (trainer-vm-diag #18889, last ts + wc -l of every market_raw v002 shard): BTCUSDT 1h 27,000 rows ending 2024-11-15; ETHUSDT 1h 24,000 ending 2024-07-13; BTCUSDT 5m 105,000 ending 2022-10-17; ADAUSDT 15m 149,000 ending 2026-01-16 -- every cut an exact 1,000-row page multiple and every file's mtime = TODAY's 00:06Z build, written as an ok row; SOLUSDT 1h over the same window is whole (43,824). The writer is build_trainer_datasets.sh's own market_raw build via ml/datasets/adapters/bybit_offvm.py: 'if not page: break' treated an EMPTY Bybit page before end as end-of-data, so one transient empty answer truncated the shard at a page boundary (the 10-13 variant, data.jsonl 151,000 vs metadata 175,296, is the in-place write dying on a 10016 error mid-stream). Consequence already visible: gate-check labels_accruing 0/2667 on every BTC/ETH 1h shadow head (relay #18887) because the realized-label candle base ends in 2024. FIX in PR #18891 (Tier-2 hold): empty page re-fetched 3x then stepped past (30 max); a fetch ending > 2 pages before end RAISES (failed build, never an ok shard); builder writes data.jsonl.tmp and renames on success. DONE WHEN (observation): after #18891 deploys, a relay read shows BTCUSDT 1h/5m, ETHUSDT 1h, ADAUSDT 15m v002 whole (rows ~ 5y of bars, last ts = previous day) and gate-check btc-regime-1h-lgbm-v2 labels_accruing > 0.3. The expected-rows check in DATA-CATALOG stays the standing detector. [2026-10-18 07:19Z] PR #18891 MERGED (squash). State landed_unproven: merged, not deployed (next ict-trainer cycle 2026-10-19 00:22Z does git reset --hard origin/main), not observed. Closes on PI-20261018-WH81NW96-0001 (whole shards + 0 failed builds) and -0002 (1h labels_accruing > 0.3).
